tools.name: rank
tools.description: Legacy v1; use decide. Deprecated fixed-benchmark ranking; scores lag the catalogue and newer models may be unranked. Which models lead a fixed use-case profile? Returns a shortlist with evidence_basis and input provenance, not a quality verdict. Needs an API key (Authorization: Bearer). Costs 1 cre

tools.name: model_info
tools.description: What does one model's card say? Reads https://modelspec.dev/api/models/<model_id>.json. Split mode returns only its display name. Needs an API key. Not current evidence or a ranking; use decide.

tools.name: list_use_cases
tools.description: Which legacy profiles and ranking rules exist? Returns https://modelspec.dev/api/rank/profiles.json with evidence floors and the neutrality commitment. Needs an API key. Use decide for decisions.

tools.name: policy_check
tools.description: Which models and platforms does my policy allow? Returns pass, fail or undetermined per model/platform for licence, origin and data handling; undetermined is not a pass. Needs an API key (Authorization: Bearer). Costs 5 credits a call; $0.0053–$0.02 per credit by plan or pack (https://modelspec.dev/

tools.name: decide
tools.description: Which models fit this job? Call decide early. Returns answer, ranked results, may_qualify, reading and recovery hints, decision_id and snapshot. Never add a gate or constraint the user didn't state. Relax only constraints the user stated, one at a time, and say what was relaxed and why. Prefer the a

tools.name: compare_models
tools.description: What facts do 2 to 4 named models have? Returns sourced snapshot facts, offerings and evidence in caller order; unknowns stay null. Needs an API key (Authorization: Bearer). Costs 2 credits a call; $0.0053–$0.02 per credit by plan or pack (https://modelspec.dev/pricing/). It doesn't choose a model a

tools.name: hardware_fit
tools.description: Does this workload fit? Returns measured for an exact cited run, estimated with sources, or undetermined. Uses basis full with sourced headroom, or basis lower_bound for unlikely only. Missing headroom cannot establish likely. Estimates never prove fit. Memory is decimal GB per device, never pooled.

tools.name: vocab
tools.description: What can a Spec say? Returns ids and task types. Needs an API key. One vocabulary lookup per unknown facet, then decide. Use decide to compare models. Starter includes a minimal Spec. Compact pages: at most 20 rows, no counts; empty pages end results. Search ranks all tokens before subsets; misses o

tools.name: feedback
tools.description: Was an answer reliable? Returns recorded/not_recorded for a rating after acting; include decision_id. Free, no key, and no Authorization header is forwarded. No prompts, keys or personal details in note; no questions or support. Storage stays off until covered by the privacy statement. Proxies POST

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: policy_check, decide · Private data: rank, model_info, list_use_cases, policy_check, decide, compare_models, hardware_fit, vocab · Public sink: rank, policy_check, decide, compare_models, hardware_fit, feedback · Destructive: hardware_fit.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: policy_check, decide · Private data: rank, model_info, list_use_cases, policy_check, decide, compare_models, hardware_fit, vocab · Public sink: rank, policy_check, decide, compare_models, hardware_fit, feedback · Destructive: hardware_fit

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
